notes: Anaerobic MOPS glucose, OD 0.25 -> mid_exponential inferred; sparged N2/CO2 with glucose and no stated acceptor -> fermentation inferred. Temperature and vessel not stated. fur;ryhB double deletion labeled deletion. WT re-read: wild-type samples of the plain standard strain set to wild_type.

oxygen.q: grown anaerobically in MOPS minimal media supplemented with 0.2% glucose sparged with a gas mix of 95% N2 and 5% CO2

treatment.q: Four RNA-seq samples each with three biological replicates were analyzed (WT, deltaFur, deltaRhyB, deltaFur_deltaRhyB)

inducer_added.q: Four RNA-seq samples each with three biological replicates were analyzed (WT, deltaFur, deltaRhyB, deltaFur_deltaRhyB)

transcription_arrested.q: Four RNA-seq samples each with three biological replicates were analyzed (WT, deltaFur, deltaRhyB, deltaFur_deltaRhyB)

mixed_organism.q: Four RNA-seq samples each with three biological replicates were analyzed (WT, deltaFur, deltaRhyB, deltaFur_deltaRhyB)

assay_class.q: Strand–specific RNA-sequencing libraries were prepared using NEBNext Ultra RNA Library Prep Kit

rrna_removal.q: Depletion of rRNA was performed using Ribozero rRNA removal kit (Bacteria probe)

is_control.q: Four RNA-seq samples each with three biological replicates were analyzed (WT, deltaFur, deltaRhyB, deltaFur_deltaRhyB)
